tactical_insights: Ecuador's goal-shy attack, led by Enner Valencia, faces a potentially rotated but deep German defense.
Germany, already qualified, can experiment, while Ecuador desperately needs a victory to advance.
Nagelsmann's fluid, high-pressing system will challenge Beccacece's disciplined, counter-attacking Ecuador setup.
